reviews.comment:
La unica persona que te trata con RESPETO y AMABILIDAD es la señorita que te realiza el examen de la vista. Las demas señoras del personal administrativo en todo momento te hablan de manera IRRESPETUOSA, ARROGANTE Y DESAFIANTEMENTE.
Cuando te llaman POR NOMBRE y APELLIDO para comenzar el turno lo hacen en un lapso de cada dos segundos, de manera apurada y cuando queres realizar una CONSULTA, porque no es un tramite que uno hace todos los dias, la señora que atiende en la OFICINA DE LA IZQUIERDA te dice: - ¿ ¡ PODES RETIRARTE ! ?, ¡ NO TENGO TODO EL DIA PARA TUS CONSULTAS, FIJATE VOS !
Textuales palabras. Tendria que haberla filmado.
Estaria bueno que mejoren EL RESPETO o pongan PERSONAL MAS JOVEN Y CAPACITADO CON TEST PSICOLOGICOS PREVIAMENTE HECHOS PARA ATENCION AL PUBLICO.
La verdad que a uno LE CUESTA LA PLATA como para que te traten como SI ELLOS TE ESTUVIERAN PRESTANDO LA PLATA.

(Translated by Google)
The only person who treats you with respect and kindness is the young woman who performs your eye exam. The other women on the administrative staff speak to you disrespectfully, arrogantly, and defiantly at all times.

When they call your first and last name to begin your appointment, they do so every two seconds, in a rushed manner. And when you want to ask a question—because it's not something you do every day—the woman in the office on the left tells you: "Can you leave? I don't have all day for your questions, figure it out yourself!" Those are her exact words. I should have filmed her.

It would be good if they improved the respect shown to customers or hired younger, better-trained staff who had undergone prior psychological testing for customer service.

The truth is, you pay for your money, and it's unacceptable to be treated like they're lending it to you.
